name: quox-voice
tagline: Talk to your agents. Governed, witnessed, interruptible.
description: Governed realtime voice conversations with CommanderQ. Speech recognition, agent reasoning and synthesis all run through the governed Quox stack: sessions are org-scoped, every one is witnessed, and you can interrupt the agent mid-sentence like a colleague. Browser first; business phone lines are the roadmap. Distinct from Advanced Voice, which provides the voice library and read-aloud controls for chat: Quox Voice is the live two-way conversation runtime.
shortDescription: Realtime governed voice conversations with your agents
author: QUOX
marketingPoints: Live spoken conversation with CommanderQ, sub-second listening, natural interruption
Every session org-scoped and witnessed: voice carries the same evidence trail as chat
The agent keeps its tools, knowledge and history; voice is a surface, not a fork
Pick a voice, or switch voices mid-conversation
Roadmap: your agents answering your business phone lines
